BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE task_test_answer_variant
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submitted_order integer NULL,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submitted_group_id uuid NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'task_test_answer_variant'::regclass
          AND conname = 'task_test_answer_variant_submitted_order_positive'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE task_test_answer_variant
            ADD CONSTRAINT task_test_answer_variant_submitted_order_positive
            CHECK (submitted_order IS NULL OR submitted_order > 0);
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Single-choice historically stored one row per question. Structured answers
-- store one row per submitted variant instead.
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task_test_answer_variant_answer_test_unique_idx;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_answer_variant_answer_test_variant_unique_idx
    ON task_test_answer_variant(student_task_answer_id, task_test_id, task_test_variant_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_answer_variant_answer_test_order_unique_idx
    ON task_test_answer_variant(student_task_answer_id, task_test_id, submitted_order)
    WHERE submitted_order IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_answer_variant_answer_test_idx
    ON task_test_answer_variant(student_task_answer_id, task_test_id);

COMMIT;
